title: AAPSClient missing entries from AAPS
body:
Both on Android 12
NS Dev15
AAPS DEV-h 
Logs attached.
Websockets ON on both.

Treatments entered by AAPS on 10:23 (25gr carbs), bolus 0.7 at 10:54 and bolus 1.1 at 12:19 not reflected on AAPSClient.

comments.body: I have the same experience. Not all comes to the AAPSclient or AAPS. The comunication problem is also by the switching profile on AAPSclient App, not always get the command trough the NS to the Master App.
could you check if there is WS reconnection around missing period?

Manual NSClient restart and AAPS yes; while troubleshooting in order to see if a restart will finally push the missing treatments.
Now if there was an instant network disconnection I cannot confirm.

Let me know if I can assist troubleshooting in any way.

Without a fully working AAPSClient and NS being able to set temp targets, enter carbs etc it's very challenging to remotely control our kid while being at school. As a workaround TeamViewer/Airdroid is used to remotely control (also SMS Commands).

Same observation...entering carbs or tt in nightscout manually or via ifttt is not displayed and taken into account in AAPS. (Infos arrive in xdrip and nightscout).
